lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Silver mist hangs upon the silent pines
A spark of gold begins to wake the land
Deep within the earth, the ancient pulse beats
Softly breathing life into the frozen ground
[Pre-Chorus]
Petals open wide to greet the morning light
The shadows fade beneath the rising sun
[Chorus]
Rise from the sleep of a thousand years
The crown of the world finds its grace
Mountains standing tall in a garment of gold
Where the spirit finds its sacred place
[Verse]
Rivers carve a path through valleys of stone
Whispers of the wind carry secrets untold
The forest breathes a deep and emerald sigh
As the seeds of olden stories unfold
[Pre-Chorus]
The stars retreat into the velvet blue
The earth awakens, ancient and anew
[Chorus]
Rise from the sleep of a thousand years
The crown of the world finds its grace
Mountains standing tall in a garment of gold
Where the spirit finds its sacred place
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
From the tiny spark to the roaring flame
The symphony of life calls every name
[Chorus]
Rise from the sleep of a thousand years
The crown of the world finds its grace
Mountains standing tall in a garment of gold
Where the spirit finds its sacred place
[Outro]
